usage.headings: Cabinet Grotesk, font-light to font-bold. Tight tracking (tracking-tight) for H1-H2.
usage.body: IBM Plex Sans, text-base, leading-relaxed for optimal readability.
usage.labels_mono: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs for technical overlines and metadata.

rules: No red for iAF product UI. Red is exclusively reserved for the Citi corporate logo arc.
Flat fills only for the iAF logo, no gradients or glows on the mark.

logos.citi_corporate: Citi logo with signature red arc. Must be placed in header alongside iAF logo.
logos.iaf_product: iAF monogram: '02 — Ligature / Shared-stem construction'. A and F share one vertical stem, single blue rail runs through A's crossbar and becomes F's arm. Flat blue fills only.

accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent_dark focus:outline-none).
accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to provided AA contrast pairs. Do not use low-contrast text.
accessibility.motion: Use prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable heavy animations for users who prefer reduced motion.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
accessibility.footer: Must include an explicit Accessibility Statement link.

layouts.header: Sticky nav. Glassmorphism backdrop (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#070B14]/70) to ensure readability over scrolling content. No complete transparency. Must contain Citi logo + iAF logo + semantic nav links.
layouts.footer: Generous padding (py-24), dark background (#070B14). Include standard corporate legalities and accessibility links.

Option_A_Kinetic_Knowledge_Graph.vibe: Immersive, dynamic, highly interactive enterprise tool.

Option_A_Kinetic_Knowledge_Graph.features: Bento grid layout for capability cards (Architecture Diagrams, Architecture Assessment, Risk & Compliance, API Catalog).
Option_A_Kinetic_Knowledge_Graph.video_showcase: Cinematic centered video slot with a subtle glowing border (#0B1F4D) and 'Play' micro-interaction.

Option_B_Technical_Blueprint.name: Technical Blueprint (Factory Floor)
Option_B_Technical_Blueprint.hero: Technical wireframe aesthetic. Uses abstract blueprint graphics and a monospace typography mix for a 'command center' feel.
Option_B_Technical_Blueprint.features: Strict grid hierarchy. High density bento grids. Left sidebar explicitly mimicking the product's 'Domains' navigation to train the user.
Option_B_Technical_Blueprint.video_showcase: Asymmetrical layout. Video placed in a hard-edged container with technical metadata overlay.

Option_C_Editorial_Enterprise.name: Editorial Enterprise
Option_C_Editorial_Enterprise.hero: High-contrast editorial layout. Large typography, structured whitespace. Spotlighted floating UI screenshots instead of abstract graphs.
Option_C_Editorial_Enterprise.features: Staggered 'Cardless' lists for features. Clean horizontal bands separating the lifecycle tabs (Draft/Review/Approved) explanation.
Option_C_Editorial_Enterprise.video_showcase: Wide, panoramic video slot acting as a visual break between content sections, surrounded by massive negative space.

components_and_sections.product_explanation: Simple architecture mapping explainer: Architecture Diagrams, Architecture Assessment, Risk & Compliance, API Catalog.

motion.staggered_reveals: Use framer-motion to stagger the entrance of bento grid items and capability cards.
motion.kinetic_typography: Masked line-by-line reveal for hero H1.

knowledge_graph_abstract.description: Abstract blue network nodes and lines, perfect for graph visualization fallback.

technical_blueprint.description: Dark blue technical wireframe sketches for Option B.

enterprise_abstract.description: Abstract blue glowing wave patterns for enterprise aesthetic.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). CRITICAL: Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds behind text or in headers over images.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component is located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx`.

instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn: Heavily customize Shadcn UI components. Use raw Tailwind/HTML for layout structures (Grid, Flex), do not wrap entire pages in Shadcn Cards.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements (links, buttons, form fields, tabs) MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility: Ensure aria-labels are present. Focus rings must be high contrast (AA). Implement `prefers-reduced-motion` utility classes on all animations.
instructions_to_main_agent.hero_video: The v6 video asset is not provided. Implement an elegant, interactive video placeholder section that prompts the user to 'Play'.
